```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Purpose

This assembles a single summary table of age-matched deviation for the three
cohorts each tissue-of-origin clock is applied to: the GTEx normal tissue the
clock was trained on, TCGA adjacent normal tissue, and TCGA primary tumors.
For each cohort it reports sample count, age distribution, and the mean,
standard deviation, 95% confidence interval, median, and interquartile range
of the deviation.

The table underlies the comparison of adjacent normal tissue against both the
GTEx reference and the matched tumors, which distinguishes the tumor shift from
a uniform offset between the GTEx and TCGA cohorts.

Tumor and adjacent-normal deviations are read from the saved ClockSHAP bundle
and are not recomputed. GTEx deviations are not stored in that bundle, so they
are computed here by applying the same saved clock and reference profile to the
GTEx feature matrix.

Adjacent normal tissue was carried forward by the processing step only where at
least `r params$min_nat` Solid Tissue Normal samples were available, so cancers
without a qualifying adjacent-normal cohort have no deviations to report and
appear with a count of zero.

Two versions are written to `r params$tables_root`: the full numeric table, and
a condensed version with the paired statistics folded into single cells so that
it fits a portrait page.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(knitr)
  library(ClockSHAP)
})

msg <- function(...) if (isTRUE(params$verbose)) message(...)
```

## Cancers of interest

These are the cross-cancer emphasis set, each paired with its GTEx tissue of
origin. Add or remove rows here to change which cancers enter the table.

```{r}
map <- list(
  BRCA = "BREAST",
  LUSC = "LUNG",
  LUAD = "LUNG",
  GBM  = "BRAIN",
  LGG  = "BRAIN",
  COAD = "COLON"
)
```

## Summary helper

Summarizes one vector of deviations and its matched ages into a single row.
Non-finite deviations are dropped. A cohort with no samples returns a row of
missing values so that it still appears in the table.

```{r}
summarise_deviation <- function(deviation, age, tissue, cancer, cohort) {

  keep <- is.finite(deviation)
  d    <- as.numeric(deviation[keep])
  a    <- as.numeric(age[keep])
  n    <- length(d)

  if (n < 2) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      tissue           = tissue,
      cancer           = cancer,
      cohort           = cohort,
      n                = n,
      age_median       = if (n > 0) stats::median(a) else NA_real_,
      age_min          = if (n > 0) min(a) else NA_real_,
      age_max          = if (n > 0) max(a) else NA_real_,
      mean_deviation   = if (n > 0) mean(d) else NA_real_,
      sd_deviation     = NA_real_,
      ci_lower         = NA_real_,
      ci_upper         = NA_real_,
      median_deviation = if (n > 0) stats::median(d) else NA_real_,
      q1_deviation     = NA_real_,
      q3_deviation     = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  se    <- stats::sd(d) / sqrt(n)
  tcrit <- stats::qt(0.975, df = n - 1)

  tibble::tibble(
    tissue           = tissue,
    cancer           = cancer,
    cohort           = cohort,
    n                = n,
    age_median       = stats::median(a),
    age_min          = min(a),
    age_max          = max(a),
    mean_deviation   = mean(d),
    sd_deviation     = stats::sd(d),
    ci_lower         = mean(d) - tcrit * se,
    ci_upper         = mean(d) + tcrit * se,
    median_deviation = stats::median(d),
    q1_deviation     = unname(stats::quantile(d, 0.25)),
    q3_deviation     = unname(stats::quantile(d, 0.75))
  )
}
```

## Load saved objects and summarize each cohort

For each cancer-tissue pair the clock objects, the ClockSHAP bundle, and the
GTEx pathway score matrix are loaded. GTEx deviations are obtained by calling
`ClockSHAP::clockshap()` with the clock and reference profile stored in the
bundle, which is the same call the tumor and adjacent-normal deviations were
produced by. The result is checked against the residual of the GTEx
prediction line, the anchoring used in the deviation figures, so that the
numbers in this table are the same quantity plotted there.

A GTEx row is emitted the first time each tissue is encountered, so lung is
carried by LUAD and LUSC together and brain by GBM and LGG together.

Values are kept at full precision here and rounded only where they are
displayed and written, so that both output tables round from the same source.

```{r}
suffix       <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)
out_root_abs <- here::here(params$out_root)

cohort_rows <- list()
gtex_done   <- character(0)

for (tcga in names(map)) {

  gtex        <- map[[tcga]]
  analysis_id <- paste0(tcga, "__", gtex)
  proc_dir    <- file.path(out_root_abs, analysis_id)

  clock_rds       <- file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clock_and_RAA_objects", suffix, ".rds"))
  clockshap_rds   <- file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clockshap_objects",     suffix, ".rds"))
  scores_gtex_rds <- file.path(proc_dir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_gtex",    suffix, ".rds"))

  if (!all(file.exists(clock_rds, clockshap_rds, scores_gtex_rds))) {
    warning("Missing saved objects for ", analysis_id, "; skipping.")
    next
  }

  clock_results <- readRDS(clock_rds)
  bundle        <- readRDS(clockshap_rds)
  scores_gtex   <- readRDS(scores_gtex_rds)

  feat <- clock_results$feature_names

  # ---- GTEx reference cohort ----
  X_gtex_full <- t(scores_gtex[feat, , drop = FALSE])
  age_gtex    <- clock_results$age$GTEx

  ids_keep    <- intersect(rownames(X_gtex_full), names(age_gtex))
  X_gtex_cs   <- X_gtex_full[ids_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  age_gtex_cs <- as.numeric(age_gtex[ids_keep])
  names(age_gtex_cs) <- ids_keep

  ok_g        <- is.finite(age_gtex_cs)
  X_gtex_cs   <- X_gtex_cs[ok_g, , drop = FALSE]
  age_gtex_cs <- age_gtex_cs[ok_g]

  cs_gtex <- ClockSHAP::clockshap(
    features  = X_gtex_cs,
    age       = age_gtex_cs,
    clock     = bundle$clock,
    reference = bundle$reference
  )

  # Deviation must equal the residual of the GTEx prediction line, which is the
  # anchoring the deviation figures use.
  pred_gtex <- clock_results$pred$GTEx
  age_line  <- clock_results$age$GTEx[names(pred_gtex)]
  ok_line   <- complete.cases(pred_gtex, age_line)
  bias_fit  <- lm(pred_gtex[ok_line] ~ age_line[ok_line])
  beta0     <- coef(bias_fit)[1]
  beta1     <- coef(bias_fit)[2]

  d_dev <- max(abs(cs_gtex$deviation - (cs_gtex$predicted - (beta0 + beta1 * cs_gtex$age))),
               na.rm = TRUE)
  msg(analysis_id, " GTEx max |deviation - line residual| = ", signif(d_dev, 3))
  stopifnot(d_dev < 1e-6)

  if (!(gtex %in% gtex_done)) {
    cohort_rows[[paste0(analysis_id, "_gtex")]] <- summarise_deviation(
      deviation = cs_gtex$deviation,
      age       = cs_gtex$age,
      tissue    = gtex,
      cancer    = "",
      cohort    = "GTEx reference"
    )
    gtex_done <- c(gtex_done, gtex)
  }

  # ---- Adjacent normal ----
  has_nat <- !is.null(bundle$nat) && length(bundle$nat$deviation) > 0

  cohort_rows[[paste0(analysis_id, "_nat")]] <- if (has_nat) {
    summarise_deviation(
      deviation = bundle$nat$deviation,
      age       = bundle$nat$age,
      tissue    = gtex,
      cancer    = tcga,
      cohort    = "Adjacent normal"
    )
  } else {
    summarise_deviation(
      deviation = numeric(0),
      age       = numeric(0),
      tissue    = gtex,
      cancer    = tcga,
      cohort    = "Adjacent normal"
    )
  }

  msg(analysis_id, " adjacent normal samples: ",
      if (has_nat) length(bundle$nat$deviation) else 0)

  # ---- Primary tumor ----
  cohort_rows[[paste0(analysis_id, "_pt")]] <- summarise_deviation(
    deviation = bundle$pt$deviation,
    age       = bundle$pt$age,
    tissue    = gtex,
    cancer    = tcga,
    cohort    = "Tumor"
  )
}

deviation_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(cohort_rows)

msg("Summarized ", nrow(deviation_summary), " cohort rows.")

tables_root_abs <- here::here(params$tables_root)
dir.create(tables_root_abs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Deviation summary table

Rows are grouped by tissue of origin, with the GTEx reference cohort first,
followed by the adjacent normal and tumor cohorts of each cancer drawn from
that tissue. All deviation values are in years.

```{r}
deviation_summary_numeric <- deviation_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(c(age_median, age_min, age_max), ~ round(.x, 1)),
    dplyr::across(c(mean_deviation, sd_deviation, ci_lower, ci_upper,
                    median_deviation, q1_deviation, q3_deviation), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

knitr::kable(
  deviation_summary_numeric,
  caption = paste0(
    "Age-matched deviation by cohort. Deviations are in years, relative to the ",
    "GTEx tissue-of-origin reference. Adjacent normal tissue was carried ",
    "forward only where at least ", params$min_nat, " Solid Tissue Normal ",
    "samples were available; cancers without a qualifying adjacent-normal ",
    "cohort appear with n = 0."
  )
)

utils::write.csv(
  deviation_summary_numeric,
  file      = file.path(tables_root_abs, "deviation_summary_by_cohort.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("Saved: ", file.path(tables_root_abs, "deviation_summary_by_cohort.csv"))
```

## Condensed table for the supplement

The same values with each pair of statistics folded into one cell, which brings
the table down to six columns. The tissue and cancer columns are merged into a
single cohort label, matching how the cohorts are named in the deviation
figures. Cohorts with no samples carry a hyphen in place of the statistics.

```{r}
deviation_summary_condensed <- deviation_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cohort = dplyr::case_when(
      cohort == "GTEx reference"  ~ paste("GTEx", tolower(tissue)),
      cohort == "Adjacent normal" ~ paste(cancer, "adjacent normal"),
      cohort == "Tumor"           ~ paste(cancer, "tumor")
    ),
    `Age, median (range)` = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(age_median), "-",
      sprintf("%.0f (%.0f-%.0f)", age_median, age_min, age_max)
    ),
    `Mean (SD)` = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(sd_deviation), "-",
      sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean_deviation, sd_deviation)
    ),
    `95% CI` = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(ci_lower), "-",
      sprintf("%.1f to %.1f", ci_lower, ci_upper)
    ),
    `Median (IQR)` = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(q1_deviation), "-",
      sprintf("%.1f (%.1f, %.1f)", median_deviation, q1_deviation, q3_deviation)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cohort, n, `Age, median (range)`, `Mean (SD)`,
                `95% CI`, `Median (IQR)`)

knitr::kable(
  deviation_summary_condensed,
  caption = "Age-matched deviation by cohort, condensed for typesetting. Deviations are in years."
)

utils::write.csv(
  deviation_summary_condensed,
  file      = file.path(tables_root_abs, "deviation_summary_by_cohort_condensed.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("Saved: ", file.path(tables_root_abs, "deviation_summary_by_cohort_condensed.csv"))
```
